def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in vals.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for c in range(W))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for r in range(H))]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
       if grid[r][c] not in (block,line)}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    nR,nC=len(mr)-1,len(mc)-1
    out=[[block]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(mr[i],mc[j]),(mr[i],mc[j+1]),(mr[i+1],mc[j]),(mr[i+1],mc[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv)==4 and len(set(cv))==1: out[i][j]=cv[0]
    return out
